protocol.selection: five seeded random questions per category 1/2/3/4 from fixed 100-question cohort, six small-pilot questions excluded; not selected for retrieval outcomes
protocol.oracle: all original required sources first, fill to16 with Hebbian distractors then chronological records; no gold answer text in prompt
protocol.scoring: primary upstream-style token F1, paired differences, 3000 conversation-cluster bootstrap draws. Secondary exact F1=1, complete source coverage, required citations, invalid IDs, abstentions. Any manual audit is secondary and disclosed separately.
protocol.decision: Diagnostic pilot only, no tuning or reversal of longitudinal stopping rule. Positive answer-quality signal requires Hebbian minus adjacency mean F1 >= .05 and paired cluster95 lower bound >0 for both models. Otherwise improvement remains unestablished.
protocol.policy: first attempts including failures, no retries, no tools, fresh sessions; locked settings match longitudinal-v1; holdout questions/answers do not train graph
protocol.scope: medium pilot, previously exposed narrow speaker-reference cohort; stratified scores are not population prevalence weighted; one completion per condition/model; token count not matched; oracle can still contain ambiguous or insufficient annotations
